email.title: Email
email.description: Mes Pages / My Pages email (sectoralarm.fr, sectoralarm.net, …).

password.title: Password
password.description: Mes Pages password (not the keypad PIN). Stored in Homebridge config.json.

code.title: Panel code
code.description: Keypad / panel PIN used to arm, disarm, lock and unlock. Stored in Homebridge config.json.

panelId.title: Panel ID
panelId.description: Optional. Leave empty if you have a single site; required if several panels are on the account.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh alarm, sensors, plugs and locks. Default 60s.

allowDisarm.title: Allow HomeKit to disarm
allowDisarm.description: If disabled, HomeKit can still arm and show status, but cannot disarm. Does not protect against someone who can read the Homebridge config file.

allowLockControl.title: Allow HomeKit to lock / unlock
allowLockControl.description: If disabled, lock state is still shown but HomeKit cannot lock or unlock.
